intended_use.population: Adults represented by PTB-XL receiving a 10-second resting ECG
intended_use.claim_boundary: Not a clinical diagnosis, device-equivalence claim, or deployment authorization

primary_analysis.interpretation: Research target inherited from the frozen policy; not clinically validated

secondary_analysis.multiplicity: Descriptive; no confirmatory claims from secondary comparisons

locking_rules: The model and policy must be frozen before test predictions are read
The test export must contain every record; max_n is forbidden
Checkpoint, label schema, target, and lead sets must match
No calibration or threshold fitting is permitted during audit
Any test-driven change creates a new model version requiring new untouched evaluation data
